title: Battle of Fort Duquesne
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fort Duquesne", at revision 1370440900, opens: "The Battle of Fort Duquesne was a British assault on the French-controlled Fort Duquesne on 14 September 1758, during the French and Indian War. This force was out-maneuvered, surrounded, and largely destroyed by the French and their native allies led by François-Marie Le Marchand de Lignery." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2391801, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1758 battle during the French and Indian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
